summary: Your college needs more papers to finish your financial aid. Until you send them, you will not get your grant money for next term.

deadlines.what: Send the verification worksheet and tax transcript
deadlines.sourceQuote: Please submit the Verification Worksheet and an IRS Tax Return Transcript no later than December 1, 2026.

steps: Log in to your student portal and download the verification worksheet.
Get your free tax return transcript from the IRS website.
Upload both papers to the financial aid office.
Ask the financial aid office to confirm they got them.
sender: Lakeside Community College Office of Financial Aid
